settings.label: Lock the store behind a countdown
settings.info: Visitors only see the countdown until the launch time, then the store opens by itself. The theme editor always shows the store.

settings.label: Launch time
settings.info: Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+05:30 (IST). Example: 2026-10-20T22:50:00+05:30 is 10:50 PM IST, 20 Oct 2026.

settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Single-color logo, recolored to the text color. Defaults to the header logo artwork.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Something soft is on its way.

settings.label: Message
settings.default: Our first collection drops tonight. Stay close.

settings.label: Image shape
settings.info: Every product card and product page image uses this shape, so rows stay aligned.

settings.label: Collection image shape
settings.info: Used by Shop by collection and the Collections page. Every tile uses the same shape so rows stay aligned.

settings.label: Gift box product
settings.info: Create a product called 'Gift box' priced at the gift box fee (e.g. ₹200). Product pages then offer 'Standard' or 'Gift box', and one gift box is added to the bag for each gift-boxed item. Leave empty to hide the option.

settings.label: Address shown for all products
settings.info: Also create a URL redirect from this path to /collections/all (Online Store > Navigation > URL redirects). Leave empty to show /collections/all.

settings.label: Blog for "Blogs" links
settings.info: Menu and footer links to /blogs open this blog.

settings.label: Homepage heading for search engines
settings.info: Hidden from shoppers. Used as the homepage H1 when the hero heading is empty. Example: Cuddles – soft cotton baby clothes made in India
settings.default: Baby clothes, swaddles and newborn essentials for 0–24 months

settings.label: Homepage title
settings.info: Used when Online Store > Preferences > Homepage title is empty or just the store name. Keep it under 60 characters.
settings.default: Cuddles by Mia & Co. | Baby Clothes & Swaddles India

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.info: Used when Online Store > Preferences > Meta description is empty. Also the fallback for pages without their own description. Aim for 140–160 characters.
settings.default: Soft, comfortable baby clothes and essentials for 0–24 months: swaddles, rompers, dresses, co-ord sets, sleeping bags and muslin towels. Delivered across India.

settings.label: Collection meta description fallback
settings.info: Used for collections without a description. [collection] is replaced with the collection name.
settings.default: Shop [collection] for babies aged 0–24 months at Cuddles by Mia & Co. Soft, breathable pieces, free shipping over ₹2,999 and delivery across India.

settings.content: Added to product structured data so Google can show delivery costs and returns. Keep these in line with your Shipping & Returns page.

settings.label: Free shipping on orders over (₹)
settings.info: Leave empty if there's no free-shipping threshold.

settings.label: Max delivery time after dispatch (working days)
Return window (days)
settings.info: Set to 0 if you don't accept returns.

settings.label: Social share image
settings.info: Shown when links to pages without their own image are shared (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook). 1200 × 630px recommended.
